summary: Iteration 10 (Papi auto toggle + manual USSD flow + delete delivered) fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (config exposes papi_auto=false & manual_only=true; POST /orders with mvola|orange returns 409 when papi_auto=false; POST /orders manual without manual_reference => 400, with reference => 201 status=awaiting_verification (never paid); /payments/initiate returns 409 when papi_auto is off (no Papi call); admin /payments/admin/settings 401 without admin, round-trip toggle ON => mvola order accepted and /payments/initiate creates a simulated pending attempt, restored OFF at teardown; admin PATCH awaiting_verification->paid->delivered works; DELETE on delivered order returns {ok:true}; DELETE on paid non-delivered returns 409). Frontend: on /commande with an item in cart, method 'Paiement manuel (USSD + référence)' is selected by default and method-mvola/method-orange buttons are NOT rendered; papi-auto-off-notice visible; pay-button labelled 'Envoyer la commande'; ussd-button opens ussd-dialog in-site (URL stays on /commande, no tel:, no window.location); modal shows provider, amount, merchant number+name, USSD code, exactly 5 ordered steps and the notice 'Après votre paiement, revenez ici et saisissez la référence de transaction.' (no 'Paiement confirmé'); ussd-copy-merchant toasts 'Copié'; ussd-next moves to confirm step; empty submit shows 'Entrez votre référence de transaction.' error and does NOT create an order (URL preserved); with a reference, both the modal ussd-submit-order AND the main pay-button create the order and redirect to /suivi/<MGS-...>?pubg_id=... with 'Vérification en cours'; closing the modal preserves the entered reference (shared state with manual-reference input in the summary). Modal usable at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 (bbox within viewport, close button visible, scrollable). Admin /admin shows papi-auto-setting with state OFF and papi-auto-toggle; toggling ON persists across reload; restored to OFF at end. Loyalty /compte/points readable in dark mode (SOLDE 30 in neon yellow on dark card, points-earned/promo cards visible, sufficient contrast) on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: UssdDialog: DialogContent triggers a Radix accessibility warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}'. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to eliminate the console warning.

PaymentMethodPicker: manual-reference input in the summary section and ussd-reference-input in the modal share the same 'reference' state (good UX). Confirm this intended shared state is documented, since closing the modal transparently keeps the value in the outer input.

backend/routers/payments.py: initiate() enforces papi_auto only for mvola/orange orders, but if papi_auto is toggled OFF between order creation and initiate, the order stays in status pending_payment forever (no auto-cancel). Consider surfacing a way to migrate such orders to manual or cancel them from admin.
backend/routers/orders.py admin_delete_order archives delivered orders in deleted_orders (append-only), leaving payments/loyalty ledger intact — good traceability.
seed_data_creation: Test-run created ~5 disposable orders (MGS-* prefixed) via public POST /api/orders; delivered order flow was self-cleaning (delete). No admin users created. papi_auto left OFF as required.
